sources.name: Craft Ventures team page, David Sacks bio

reading.body:
Craft Ventures' only AI exposure in this record is an investment, not a product: a third backing of Horizon3, a $250M Series E at a $2B+ valuation.

That is the whole pattern. The firm is a for-profit investor headquartered in San Francisco, and its AI position runs entirely through portfolio companies rather than anything it builds or operates. Horizon3's autonomous AI hacking is framed as security validation, trusted by 7,000+ organizations including four Fortune 10 companies. For AI scaling, this matters only indirectly: security validation is a precondition for deploying models in regulated and large enterprises, and capital flowing to that layer is capital flowing to the gatekeepers rather than to compute, buildings, or power.

The record does not connect Craft Ventures to data centers, electricity, or chip supply, and it should not be read as doing so. It also lists 281 California legal exposure entries without naming a single case, so the nature and severity of that exposure is unknown. No products are listed for the firm, and no other AI investments appear. The data covers one investment and one legal count, and nothing about the firm's fund size, portfolio breadth, or actual influence over AI infrastructure.

profile_text.body:
Craft Ventures is a venture capital firm based in San Francisco, California. On its own site the firm describes itself as a team of former founders, operators, and experts, and as a team of senior operators and investors with one goal of helping founders build great companies. It says it was built from the ground up to be the type of venture firm its partners wished they had when they were founders, describing itself as low maintenance but high value-add, and says it gives founders access to senior talent.

The firm's site states that it knows what it takes to build unicorn companies because it has done so itself. Its team page includes a bio for David Sacks.

Among the facts held about the company, it is recorded as a for-profit investor organization. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 282.
